.from("providers").select(PUBLIC_PROVIDER_COLUMNS).in("id", ids).eq("status", "approved")
```

**`getApprovedProvidersByIds` (lines 244-251):**
```
.from("providers").select(PUBLIC_PROVIDER_COLUMNS).in("id", ids).eq("status", "approved")
